preservation_method: Archival ancestry anchor. The snapshot tree equals the captured default tree plus this manifest. Other branch tips are retained as parents, directly or through grouped archival commits. This is not a merge of their file contents. Do not merge this archival branch into development. verification: Parent objects, archive tree, manifest and final branch ref are read back after creation. No production deployment or database restore performed.
